name: Jersey Mike's Subs Receipt
description: This receipt is a Jersey Mike’s Subs quick-service restaurant transaction formatted in a standard POS thermal print layout for a takeout order. It includes full store identification with store number, address, and phone number, along with a ticket number and server name. The receipt features a timestamp and clearly structured sections including item listing, discount application (loyalty program), and a financial summary showing subtotal, taxable amount, tax, total, tendered cash, and change. Additional POS metadata includes items sold count, loyalty program identifiers (JM Club number and registration code), and points tracking details. The layout uses dashed separators and aligned totals consistent with U.S. fast-casual restaurant receipt formatting.
